channel.title: Zambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Zambia, every source cited.

item.title: Mweetwa reaffirms loyalty to President Hichilema
item.description: Choma Central MP Cornelius Mweetwa states he is a "disciple" of the President after not being appointed to Cabinet.

item.title: Konkola Copper Mines employs 14,500 in Zambia
item.description: The mining company's workforce has grown 30 percent since Vedanta's reinstatement, with salaries also increasing.

item.title: Freddie Mwila Snr dies aged 80
item.description: The former Zambia captain and coach died at Maina Soko Medical Centre in Lusaka on Monday.

item.title: ZCSA intensifies mobile money scam awareness
item.description: Scammers use advanced social engineering tactics to bypass security measures and trap users.

item.title: FAZ fines Power Dynamos and Nkana K100,000 each
item.description: Football Association of Zambia penalizes clubs for political chants at matches.
